_comment: REG-323 T4.5 / plan D-9. A browser AI never sends config.json (the ingest policy denies it); it may PROPOSE property changes in npdev-config-proposal.json, and npdev_relay_config.py sorts each one. `entries` is EMPTY ON PURPOSE (finding of 2026-11-12, see `located`): config.schema.json holds nothing a person would ask a chat AI to change, and every user-facing knob that was imagined (language, date format, currency, page size, time zone) lives in model.json, which the AI already changes through model.json. A knob gets an entry only if it lives OUTSIDE model.json AND an existing CLI command writes it (`writer`, registered in npdev_relay_config.WRITERS): no writer, no knob. Until then every proposal is shown as 'you can do that in Settings' and never applied.

entryShape.property: dotted path in config.json, e.g. console.mode
entryShape.values: for enum: the allowed values; for integer: {"min": n, "max": n}
entryShape.writer: the name of a function registered in npdev_relay_config.WRITERS that calls an existing CLI command (never a raw file write)

located.how: settings.locale (informational tag) and settings.strings (the text that is actually overridden)
presentationMetadata.currency on the field or concept that shows money

the app's theme is config.json defaults["ui.theme.name"] (a built-in id or a themes/<id>.json beside model.json) and defaults["ui.theme.choices"] the ones an end user may pick (flat keys; model.schema.json's settings.ui takes only pageRows and dateFormat); guidePage.theme in model.json sets one guide page's own look. No CLI command writes `defaults` yet, so there is no entry: the theme FILE arrives with T4.3 (a themes/*.json answer), the selection stays the owner's
no built-in setting: declare a properties[] entry so the scoped-property cascade carries it
scenario.name is the app's IDENTITY (it names the output folder), so it is never changed from a chat
